response: ["The 7-point score is driven by the streaks, pigmentation, and dots_and_globules criteria.", "Streaks are irregular and contribute 1 point to the score.", "Pigmentation is diffuse irregular and contributes 1 point to the score.", "Dots_and_globules are irregular and contribute 1 point to the score.", "The major criteria pigment_network, blue_whitish_veil, and vascular_structures are absent and contribute 0 points.", "Regression_structures are absent and contribute 0 points.", "To evaluate the image, look for irregular streaks, which are unevenly distributed radial lines or pseudopods.", "Look for diffuse irregular pigmentation, which are asymmetric blotches of pigment.", "Look for irregular dots or globules, which have varied size and uneven distribution.", "Dermatoscopy should be used for the assessment of pigmented and non-pigmented skin lesions.", "Whole-body photography with sequential examinations should be used for early detection of melanoma in high-risk patients.", "Sequential digital dermatoscopy can improve early detection of melanoma and should be used in high-risk patients with a high total nevus count."]
